summary: Enlight Renewable Energy filed a Form 6-K furnishing its first-quarter 2026 earnings press release and conference call presentation. The filing discloses normal quarterly financial results—total revenues and income of $200 million, net income of $38 million, and Adjusted EBITDA of $154 million—along with reaffirmed 2026 guidance. There is no mention of an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or any other special situation. The document is a routine earnings report furnished under Rule 13a-16 and does not constitute a material definitive agreement or trigger a special-situation classification. It is incorporated by reference only into an existing S-8 registration statement.
